claims.text: resqlite's page-cache configuration is already warm and healthy on its read hot paths: `sqlite3_db_status` summed over the writer and idle readers reads 99.9-100% cache hit rates, zero cache spill and zero lookaside misses across point lookups, parameterized page reads, large result reads and a write burst, so a process-global page cache or more aggressive cache tuning is not warranted.
claims.conditions: 2026-04 macOS, JIT, `benchmark/experiments/db_status_probe.dart`; each workload runs reads with no commit interleaved between them, or writes alone. Minted 2026-09-11 by exp 289 from the experiment's own Results; backfilled.
